stemMarkdown: 25 workers, each working 7 hours a day, can complete a job in 20 days. How many days will 9 workers, each working 10 hours a day, take to complete the same job? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total work $= 25 \times 20 \times 7$ worker-hours $= 3500$. With 9 workers at 10 hours/day, days needed $= \dfrac{3500}{9\times10} = 38.89$.
